source_text: She’s rough on the outside, but in here, I see lots of potential.

structure.raw_value: HeHaEx.She’s rough on the outside, but in here, I see lots of potential.
structure.script_literal: "HeHaEx.She’s rough on the outside, but in here, I see lots of potential."

translation: Na zewnątrz jest szorstka, ale w środku widzę w niej wielki potencjał.

source_text: I can hardly believe I’m doing this.

structure.raw_value: McHaOp.I can hardly believe I’m doing this.
structure.script_literal: "McHaOp.I can hardly believe I’m doing this."

translation: Aż trudno mi uwierzyć, że to robię.

source_text: And 1Hero. If you ever need any help, I’m here for you.

structure.raw_value: HeFrEx.And 1Hero. If you ever need any help, I’m here for you.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrEx.And 1Hero. If you ever need any help, I’m here for you."

translation: I jeszcze jedno, 1Hero. Gdybyś kiedykolwiek potrzebował pomocy, jestem do twojej dyspozycji.

source_text: Still on the clock.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Still on the clock.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Still on the clock."

translation: Wciąż jestem na służbie.

source_text: I won't keep you. But I’m glad I can be here to share this moment.

structure.raw_value: HeFrOp.I won't keep you. But I’m glad I can be here to share this moment.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrOp.I won't keep you. But I’m glad I can be here to share this moment."

translation: Nie będę cię zatrzymywać. Cieszę się, że mogę być tu z tobą w tej chwili.

source_text: I’m moving up in the world.

structure.raw_value: McHaOp.I’m moving up in the world.
structure.script_literal: "McHaOp.I’m moving up in the world."

translation: Wspinam się po szczeblach kariery.

source_text: Have any big plans for your first night in the house?

structure.raw_value: HeFlOp.Have any big plans for your first night in the house?
structure.script_literal: "HeFlOp.Have any big plans for your first night in the house?"

translation: Masz jakieś wielkie plany na pierwszą noc w nowym domu?

source_text: Honestly, I’ve not thought about it.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Honestly, I’ve not thought about it.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Honestly, I’ve not thought about it."

translation: Szczerze mówiąc, jeszcze o tym nie myślałem.

source_text: Well you better get thinking. This place needs some decorating.

structure.raw_value: HeHaOp.Well you better get thinking. This place needs some decorating.
structure.script_literal: "HeHaOp.Well you better get thinking. This place needs some decorating."

translation: Lepiej zacznij myśleć. To miejsce trzeba jakoś urządzić.

source_text: TV trays and bean bag chairs?

structure.raw_value: McFlDe.TV trays and bean bag chairs?
structure.script_literal: "McFlDe.TV trays and bean bag chairs?"

translation: Stoliki pod telewizor i pufy?

source_text: Very funny, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: HeFlOp.Very funny, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "HeFlOp.Very funny, 1Hero."

translation: Bardzo śmieszne, 1Hero.

source_text: You know… If you’re not doing anything tonight, I’m having Carol over for dinner.

structure.raw_value: HeFrEx.You know… If you’re not doing anything tonight, I’m having Carol over for dinner.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrEx.You know… If you’re not doing anything tonight, I’m having Carol over for dinner."

translation: Wiesz… Jeśli dziś wieczorem nie masz planów, zaprosiłam Carol na kolację.

source_text: With Chloe?

structure.raw_value: McBaOP.With Chloe?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOP.With Chloe?"

translation: Z Chloe?

source_text: I hope so. You know how she is.

structure.raw_value: HeFrEx.I hope so. You know how she is.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrEx.I hope so. You know how she is."

translation: Mam nadzieję. Wiesz, jaka ona jest.

source_text: Say, why don’t you go invite Hannah? Maybe then Chloe will stick around.

structure.raw_value: HeHaEx.Say, why don’t you go invite Hannah? Maybe then Chloe will stick around.
structure.script_literal: "HeHaEx.Say, why don’t you go invite Hannah? Maybe then Chloe will stick around."

translation: Może zaprosisz Hannah? Wtedy Chloe może zostanie na dłużej.

source_text: I’m pretty busy with work. But I think I can go pay her a visit.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.I’m pretty busy with work. But I think I can go pay her a visit.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.I’m pretty busy with work. But I think I can go pay her a visit."

translation: Mam sporo pracy, ale chyba mogę do niej zajrzeć.

source_text: I saw Chloe at church today.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I saw Chloe at church today.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I saw Chloe at church today."

translation: Widziałam dziś Chloe w kościele.

source_text: Church?

structure.raw_value: HeWoOp.Church?
structure.script_literal: "HeWoOp.Church?"

translation: W kościele?

source_text: Eve Cathedral. She was visiting Sister Judy.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Eve Cathedral. She was visiting Sister Judy.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Eve Cathedral. She was visiting Sister Judy."

translation: W Katedrze Ewy. Odwiedziła siostrę Judy.

source_text: I’m stumped. Who is Sister Judy?

structure.raw_value: HeWoOp.I’m stumped. Who is Sister Judy?
structure.script_literal: "HeWoOp.I’m stumped. Who is Sister Judy?"

translation: Nie kojarzę. Kim jest siostra Judy?

source_text: She was the counselor at Saint Dame University.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.She was the counselor at Saint Dame University.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.She was the counselor at Saint Dame University."

translation: Była doradczynią na Uniwersytecie Saint Dame.

source_text: That’s right! I remember her.

structure.raw_value: HeFrOp.That’s right! I remember her.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrOp.That’s right! I remember her."

translation: Racja! Pamiętam ją.

source_text: You think Chloe is having troubles?

structure.raw_value: HeSaOp.You think Chloe is having troubles?
structure.script_literal: "HeSaOp.You think Chloe is having troubles?"

translation: Myślisz, że Chloe ma jakieś problemy?

source_text: Something is up with her. But I'm not sure what it is.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Something is up with her. But I'm not sure what it is.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Something is up with her. But I'm not sure what it is."

translation: Coś jest z nią nie tak, ale nie wiem co.

source_text: Why wouldn’t she come to me?... I’m her mother.

structure.raw_value: HeSaOp.Why wouldn’t she come to me?... I’m her mother.
structure.script_literal: "HeSaOp.Why wouldn’t she come to me?... I’m her mother."

translation: Czemu nie przyszła do mnie?... Jestem jej matką.

source_text: Don’t think about it too much, Heather. I’m sure whatever it is, she will sort it out.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Don’t think about it too much, Heather. I’m sure whatever it is, she will sort it out.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Don’t think about it too much, Heather. I’m sure whatever it is, she will sort it out."

translation: Nie zamartwiaj się, Heather. Cokolwiek się dzieje, na pewno sobie z tym poradzi.

source_text: I won't tell her you said anything, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: HeFrOp.I won't tell her you said anything, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrOp.I won't tell her you said anything, 1Hero."

translation: Nie powiem jej, że coś mówiłeś, 1Hero.

source_text: Now you better get back to work. This house isn’t going to pay for itself.

structure.raw_value: HeFlEx.Now you better get back to work. This house isn’t going to pay for itself.
structure.script_literal: "HeFlEx.Now you better get back to work. This house isn’t going to pay for itself."

translation: A teraz wracaj do pracy. Ten dom sam się nie spłaci.

source_text: See you at dinner.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.See you at dinner.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.See you at dinner."

translation: Do zobaczenia na kolacji.

source_text: Bring Hannah.

structure.raw_value: HeFlOp.Bring Hannah.
structure.script_literal: "HeFlOp.Bring Hannah."

translation: Przyprowadź Hannah.

source_text: Dear Heavens! What is this place? Are we trapped?

structure.raw_value: ArWoClNo1.Dear Heavens! What is this place? Are we trapped?
structure.script_literal: "ArWoClNo1.Dear Heavens! What is this place? Are we trapped?"

translation: O rany! Co to za miejsce? Jesteśmy uwięzieni?

source_text: This is my home.

structure.raw_value: McHaEx.This is my home.
structure.script_literal: "McHaEx.This is my home."

translation: To mój dom.

source_text: You live in a box? How does that work?

structure.raw_value: ArShCl.You live in a box? How does that work?
structure.script_literal: "ArShCl.You live in a box? How does that work?"

translation: Mieszkasz w pudełku? Jak to działa?

source_text: This is what houses look like on Earth… Well… some of them.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.This is what houses look like on Earth… Well… some of them.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.This is what houses look like on Earth… Well… some of them."

translation: Tak wyglądają domy na Ziemi… No… niektóre z nich.

source_text: Oh! It’s… lovely.

structure.raw_value: ArFrClNo4.Oh! It’s… lovely.
structure.script_literal: "ArFrClNo4.Oh! It’s… lovely."

translation: Och! Jest… uroczy.

source_text: As surreal as it is having a guardian angel around me, I need to get to the mansion soon.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.As surreal as it is having a guardian angel around me, I need to get to the mansion soon.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.As surreal as it is having a guardian angel around me, I need to get to the mansion soon."

translation: Obecność anioła stróża jest dość surrealistyczna, ale muszę wkrótce jechać do rezydencji.

source_text: No rush, 1Hero. Your boss will be there when you show up.

structure.raw_value: ArFrEx.No rush, 1Hero. Your boss will be there when you show up.
structure.script_literal: "ArFrEx.No rush, 1Hero. Your boss will be there when you show up."

translation: Nie spiesz się, 1Hero. Twoja szefowa będzie tam, kiedy dotrzesz.

source_text: It’s God’s will?

structure.raw_value: McFrDe.It’s God’s will?
structure.script_literal: "McFrDe.It’s God’s will?"

translation: Takie jest Boże zrządzenie?

source_text: It sure is!

structure.raw_value: ArHaAg.It sure is!
structure.script_literal: "ArHaAg.It sure is!"

translation: Oczywiście!

source_text: So… what if I went to the farm to talk to Hannah? Would I be late?

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.So… what if I went to the farm to talk to Hannah? Would I be late?
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.So… what if I went to the farm to talk to Hannah? Would I be late?"

translation: A jeśli pojechałbym na farmę porozmawiać z Hannah? Spóźniłbym się?

source_text: Really? It seems like I’d be late.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Really? It seems like I’d be late.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Really? It seems like I’d be late."

translation: Naprawdę? Wydaje mi się, że bym się spóźnił.

source_text: This one is open, 1Hero. Go wherever your heart takes you.

structure.raw_value: ArHaEx.This one is open, 1Hero. Go wherever your heart takes you.
structure.script_literal: "ArHaEx.This one is open, 1Hero. Go wherever your heart takes you."

translation: Ta ścieżka jest otwarta, 1Hero. Idź za głosem serca.

source_text: If you’re right, this kind of information is pretty helpful.

structure.raw_value: McHaOp.If you’re right, this kind of information is pretty helpful.
structure.script_literal: "McHaOp.If you’re right, this kind of information is pretty helpful."

translation: Jeśli masz rację, takie informacje są bardzo przydatne.

source_text: That’s my job. To be helpful!

structure.raw_value: ArFrEx.That’s my job. To be helpful!
structure.script_literal: "ArFrEx.That’s my job. To be helpful!"

translation: Taka moja rola. Mam pomagać!

source_text: If you’re ever stuck, just ask me for help.

structure.raw_value: ArHaEx.If you’re ever stuck, just ask me for help.
structure.script_literal: "ArHaEx.If you’re ever stuck, just ask me for help."

translation: Jeśli kiedykolwiek utkniesz, po prostu poproś mnie o pomoc.

source_text: How do I… summon you?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.How do I… summon you?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.How do I… summon you?"

translation: Jak mam cię… przywołać?

source_text: Bring up your inventory. Do you remember how?

structure.raw_value: ArHaEx.Bring up your inventory. Do you remember how?
structure.script_literal: "ArHaEx.Bring up your inventory. Do you remember how?"

translation: Otwórz ekwipunek. Pamiętasz jak?

branch_path.branch_label: Yes. I know how to open my inventory.
No. Please explain again how to open the inventory.

source_text: Open your inventory by tapping two fingers on your screen.

structure.raw_value: ArFrEx.Open your inventory by tapping two fingers on your screen.
structure.script_literal: "ArFrEx.Open your inventory by tapping two fingers on your screen."

translation: Otwórz ekwipunek, dotykając ekranu dwoma palcami.

branch_path.branch_label: Yes. I know how to open my inventory.
No. Please explain again how to open the inventory.

source_text: Open your inventory by right clicking your mouse or pressing the ‘Esc’ key on your keyboard.

structure.raw_value: ArFrEx.Open your inventory by right clicking your mouse or pressing the ‘Esc’ key on your keyboard.
structure.script_literal: "ArFrEx.Open your inventory by right clicking your mouse or pressing the ‘Esc’ key on your keyboard."

translation: Otwórz ekwipunek, klikając prawym przyciskiem myszy lub naciskając klawisz „Esc”.

branch_path.branch_label: Yes. I know how to open my inventory.

source_text: Anytime you need help, select the Oracle from your inventory.

structure.raw_value: ArFrOp.Anytime you need help, select the Oracle from your inventory.
structure.script_literal: "ArFrOp.Anytime you need help, select the Oracle from your inventory."

translation: Gdy będziesz potrzebował pomocy, wybierz Wyrocznię z ekwipunku.

source_text: I’ll call Chloe and Heather and let them know you’re okay.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.I’ll call Chloe and Heather and let them know you’re okay.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.I’ll call Chloe and Heather and let them know you’re okay."

translation: Zadzwonię do Chloe i Heather, żeby wiedziały, że wszystko z tobą w porządku.

source_text: Thank you, 1Hero. I don’t want to worry them.

structure.raw_value: JuFrCl.Thank you, 1Hero. I don’t want to worry them.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrCl.Thank you, 1Hero. I don’t want to worry them."

translation: Dziękuję, 1Hero. Nie chcę ich martwić.

source_text: Go to the bedroom. You can stay with me tonight.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Go to the bedroom. You can stay with me tonight.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Go to the bedroom. You can stay with me tonight."

translation: Idź do sypialni. Możesz dziś u mnie zostać.

source_text: You’re so kind to me.

structure.raw_value: JuFrOp.You’re so kind to me.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrOp.You’re so kind to me."

translation: Jesteś dla mnie taki dobry.

source_text: 1Hero? Did you find her?

structure.raw_value: HeWoOp#.1Hero? Did you find her?
structure.script_literal: "HeWoOp#.1Hero? Did you find her?"

translation: 1Hero? Znalazłeś ją?

source_text: She came over to my place.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.She came over to my place.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.She came over to my place."

translation: Przyszła do mnie.

source_text: Oh, thank goodness.

structure.raw_value: HeFrOp.Oh, thank goodness.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrOp.Oh, thank goodness."

translation: Och, całe szczęście.

source_text: Don’t worry. She’ll stay with me tonight.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Don’t worry. She’ll stay with me tonight.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Don’t worry. She’ll stay with me tonight."

translation: Nie martw się. Zostanie dziś u mnie.

source_text: Chloe will be relieved… But why did she leave in the middle of the night?

structure.raw_value: HeFrOp.Chloe will be relieved… But why did she leave in the middle of the night?
structure.script_literal: "HeFrOp.Chloe will be relieved… But why did she leave in the middle of the night?"

translation: Chloe odetchnie z ulgą… Ale czemu wyszła w środku nocy?

source_text: It’ll be fine. Chloe can come over in the morning.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.It’ll be fine. Chloe can come over in the morning.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.It’ll be fine. Chloe can come over in the morning."

translation: Wszystko będzie dobrze. Chloe może przyjść rano.

source_text: Is Erica really coming over tonight?...

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Is Erica really coming over tonight?...
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Is Erica really coming over tonight?..."

translation: Erica naprawdę przyjdzie dziś wieczorem?...

source_text: When is she going to get here? Should I call her?...

structure.raw_value: McWoDe.When is she going to get here? Should I call her?...
structure.script_literal: "McWoDe.When is she going to get here? Should I call her?..."

translation: Kiedy przyjdzie? Może do niej zadzwonię?...

source_text: No… I can’t look desperate…

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.No… I can’t look desperate…
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.No… I can’t look desperate…"

translation: Nie… Nie mogę wyjść na zdesperowanego…

source_text: I mean… I’m not desperate.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.I mean… I’m not desperate.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.I mean… I’m not desperate."

translation: To znaczy… Wcale nie jestem zdesperowany.

source_text: I see you found the place okay.

structure.raw_value: McHaEx.I see you found the place okay.
structure.script_literal: "McHaEx.I see you found the place okay."

translation: Widzę, że bez problemu trafiłaś.

source_text: A short walk. But it is getting dark outside.

structure.raw_value: ErFrEx.A short walk. But it is getting dark outside.
structure.script_literal: "ErFrEx.A short walk. But it is getting dark outside."

translation: To niedaleko. Ale na dworze robi się ciemno.

source_text: So… What did you want to talk about?

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.So… What did you want to talk about?
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.So… What did you want to talk about?"

translation: No więc… O czym chciałeś porozmawiać?

source_text: Right to business?

structure.raw_value: ErFlDe.Right to business?
structure.script_literal: "ErFlDe.Right to business?"

translation: Od razu do rzeczy?

source_text: Well… I mean.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Well… I mean.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Well… I mean."

translation: Cóż… To znaczy…

source_text: I brought some drinks…

structure.raw_value: ErFlEx.I brought some drinks…
structure.script_literal: "ErFlEx.I brought some drinks…"

translation: Przyniosłem coś do picia…

source_text: Where can we drink?... This place is a bit empty.

structure.raw_value: ErBaOp.Where can we drink?... This place is a bit empty.
structure.script_literal: "ErBaOp.Where can we drink?... This place is a bit empty."

translation: Gdzie możemy się napić?... Trochę tu pusto.

source_text: Oh, uhh. I have a place we can sit down…

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Oh, uhh. I have a place we can sit down…
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Oh, uhh. I have a place we can sit down…"

translation: Och, yyy. Znam miejsce, gdzie możemy usiąść…

source_text: Hannah? Chloe? What are you two doing here?

structure.raw_value: McShClNo1.Hannah? Chloe? What are you two doing here?
structure.script_literal: "McShClNo1.Hannah? Chloe? What are you two doing here?"

translation: Hannah? Chloe? Co wy tu robicie?

source_text: It’s Sunday! We’re bored.

structure.raw_value: HnHaEx.It’s Sunday! We’re bored.
structure.script_literal: "HnHaEx.It’s Sunday! We’re bored."

translation: Jest niedziela! Nudzimy się.

source_text: We got you a housewarming gift.

structure.raw_value: ChFrEx.We got you a housewarming gift.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrEx.We got you a housewarming gift."

translation: Przyniosłyśmy ci prezent na parapetówkę.

source_text: A gift? Uhh… This might be a bad time.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.A gift? Uhh… This might be a bad time.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.A gift? Uhh… This might be a bad time."

translation: Prezent? Yyy… To chyba nie najlepszy moment.

source_text: Like hell, it is! We gotta catch you before you start working.

structure.raw_value: HnFlDe.Like hell, it is! We gotta catch you before you start working.
structure.script_literal: "HnFlDe.Like hell, it is! We gotta catch you before you start working."

translation: Właśnie że najlepszy! Musimy cię złapać, zanim zaczniesz pracować.

source_text: Show him the gift.

structure.raw_value: ChFrOp.Show him the gift.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrOp.Show him the gift."

translation: Pokaż mu prezent.

source_text: Hahaha!

structure.raw_value: HnHaAgNo2.Hahaha!
structure.script_literal: "HnHaAgNo2.Hahaha!"

translation: Hahaha!

source_text: Hannah! That’s not what I told you to wrap!

structure.raw_value: ChShClNo1.Hannah! That’s not what I told you to wrap!
structure.script_literal: "ChShClNo1.Hannah! That’s not what I told you to wrap!"

translation: Hannah! Nie to kazałam ci zapakować!

source_text: I changed my mind.

structure.raw_value: HnFlEx.I changed my mind.
structure.script_literal: "HnFlEx.I changed my mind."

translation: Zmieniłam zdanie.

source_text: Look, I appreciate the… generosity… but I need you all to leave.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Look, I appreciate the… generosity… but I need you all to leave.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Look, I appreciate the… generosity… but I need you all to leave."

translation: Doceniam tę… hojność… ale musicie już wyjść.

source_text: I’m sorry, 1Hero. This wasn’t my idea.

structure.raw_value: ChSaCl.I’m sorry, 1Hero. This wasn’t my idea.
structure.script_literal: "ChSaCl.I’m sorry, 1Hero. This wasn’t my idea."

translation: Przepraszam, 1Hero. To nie był mój pomysł.

source_text: You two are party poopers. I ain’t leaving.

structure.raw_value: HnAnDe.You two are party poopers. I ain’t leaving.
structure.script_literal: "HnAnDe.You two are party poopers. I ain’t leaving."

translation: Ale z was nudziary. Nigdzie się nie wybieram.

source_text: Why did you do that, Hannah!? I can’t believe you went back to that porn shop.

structure.raw_value: ChAnOp.Why did you do that, Hannah!? I can’t believe you went back to that porn shop.
structure.script_literal: "ChAnOp.Why did you do that, Hannah!? I can’t believe you went back to that porn shop."

translation: Czemu to zrobiłaś, Hannah!? Nie wierzę, że znowu poszłaś do tego sklepu erotycznego.

source_text: I didn’t get it from a porn shop, Chloe.

structure.raw_value: HnFlEx.I didn’t get it from a porn shop, Chloe.
structure.script_literal: "HnFlEx.I didn’t get it from a porn shop, Chloe."

translation: Nie kupiłam tego w sklepie erotycznym, Chloe.

source_text: Aren’t you going to introduce me to your friends?

structure.raw_value: ErFlOp>.Aren’t you going to introduce me to your friends?
structure.script_literal: "ErFlOp>.Aren’t you going to introduce me to your friends?"

translation: Nie przedstawisz mnie swoim znajomym?

source_text: 1Hero?

structure.raw_value: ChShClNo1.1Hero?
structure.script_literal: "ChShClNo1.1Hero?"

translation: 1Hero?

source_text: Erica!? Your clothes!

structure.raw_value: McWoClNo1.Erica!? Your clothes!
structure.script_literal: "McWoClNo1.Erica!? Your clothes!"

translation: Erica!? Gdzie twoje ubrania?

source_text: I couldn't find my shorts.

structure.raw_value: ErFrEx>.I couldn't find my shorts.
structure.script_literal: "ErFrEx>.I couldn't find my shorts."

translation: Nie mogłam znaleźć spodenek.

source_text: Hannah! We should have called first!

structure.raw_value: ChWoCl.Hannah! We should have called first!
structure.script_literal: "ChWoCl.Hannah! We should have called first!"

translation: Hannah! Powinniśmy byli najpierw zadzwonić!

structure.script_literal: "HnShOpNo1.So, now you’re saying you don’t like the dildo?"

structure.raw_value: McSaOp.I’m sorry, Erica. It’s just… I have things in my life I need to sort out.

structure.raw_value: HeFrEx^.At least we have a good man in 1Hero to help us.

translation: Heh. Będę o tym pamiętać.

source_text: Hmm… I guess I can let it out of the box.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Hmm… I guess I can let it out of the box.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Hmm… I guess I can let it out of the box."

source_text: Kitty… This is your new home. How do you like it?

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Kitty… This is your new home. How do you like it?
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Kitty… This is your new home. How do you like it?"

source_text: Hey! That’s not a scratching post!

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Hey! That’s not a scratching post!
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Hey! That’s not a scratching post!"

source_text: No! No! No! Don’t poop on the ground!

structure.script_literal: "McShCl.No! No! No! Don’t poop on the ground!"

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.This is not what I was hoping for.

structure.raw_value: ChWoOp.1Hero!? What was all that noise?
structure.script_literal: "ChWoOp.1Hero!? What was all that noise?"

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Chloe!? What are you doing here?

structure.script_literal: "ChFrEx.I was looking for you. I wanted to see if you were off work yet."

source_text: Is that a cat!?

structure.raw_value: ChShClNo1.Is that a cat!?
structure.script_literal: "ChShClNo1.Is that a cat!?"

source_text: Yeah, I found him at the police station.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Yeah, I found him at the police station.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Yeah, I found him at the police station."

structure.raw_value: ChHaAg.Awww! It’s so cute!

source_text: They wanted me to euthanize it.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.They wanted me to euthanize it.

structure.raw_value: ChWoCl.1Hero, you can’t!
structure.script_literal: "ChWoCl.1Hero, you can’t!"

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.I wasn’t going to kill it… But I really don’t want to keep it.

source_text: Can I have him?

structure.raw_value: ChFrOp.Can I have him?
structure.script_literal: "ChFrOp.Can I have him?"

source_text: Would Heather be okay with that?

structure.raw_value: ChFrOp.It can’t hurt to ask.

structure.raw_value: ChHaOp.Nonsense! I’d love to take care of this little fella!

source_text: We better talk this over with your mom.
